description: Replace the first occurrence of old_text with new_text in the pinned core-memory block. Returns error: not_found if old_text is absent, or core_memory_full if the result would exceed char_limit. Use this to update or compact the block.

namespace.description: Namespace within scope (e.g., project name, team name)

new_text.description: Replacement text for the first occurrence of old_text

old_text.description: Substring to find (first occurrence) in the core-memory block

name: core_memory_replace
